meta.title: onespec — The window & door configurator for your website
meta.description: onespec is the window and door configurator widget you embed via iframe: automatic quotes, always up-to-date pricing, brandable for your company.

footer.tagline: The window & door configurator that sells for you.

hero.title: The window & door configurator that qualifies your leads for you
hero.subtitle: A widget you embed on your site with an iFrame code. Automatic quotes, an always-current price list, your brand.

configurator.title: This is the configurator. Try it now.
configurator.subtitle: Two interactive demos, identical to the product. Try them side by side: the configurator for your customers and the one for your team. On your site you use your own price list and brand.

valueProp.title: Every day you lose time on requests that go nowhere
valueProp.body: Curiosity calls, pointless site visits, competitors posing as customers just to undercut you on price. onespec puts a configurator between you and these requests: whoever reaches you has already figured out the product and the budget.

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't

items.title: One iFrame, and you're live
items.description: You paste a code on your site and the configurator appears, already working. No development, no technical maintenance.

items.title: 100% brandable
items.description: Colors, fonts and logo of your configurator match your brand. Your customer won't even know onespec exists.

items.title: Price list from CSV, always up to date
items.description: Import your price list from a CSV file (materials, glazing, finishes, hardware) and refine it from the platform. Every change is instantly live wherever the widget is installed.

items.title: Filters out anyone who isn't a real buyer
items.description: No more wasting time on people who only want to compare prices to undercut you. The configurator qualifies the request before it reaches you.

items.title: Prices close to reality
items.description: Configurable pricing rules for materials, sizes and finishes: the quote the customer sees is almost the final one.

items.title: Instant updates
items.description: You update the configurator from the onespec platform: changes go live on every site where it's installed, immediately.

dashboard.title: Quotes come in, you see them in real time
dashboard.subtitle: Every request the configurator generates lands straight in the dashboard: how many come in, from which products, and how the average value grows month after month.

steps.title: From price list to a live quote in four steps

items.title: Import your price list
items.description: Upload a CSV file with materials, glazing, finishes and prices, then complete sizes and rules from the platform.

items.title: Brand the widget
items.description: Colors, logo, copy and pricing rules from the platform. No code required.

items.title: Paste the iFrame code
items.description: The configurator appears on your site, responsive on desktop and mobile, ready to collect requests.

items.title: Receive qualified quotes
items.description: Every request arrives already with sizes, materials and the customer's indicative budget.

pricing.title: You pay based on how hard the configurator works for you
pricing.subtitle: Seven plans, from the quote tool on your website to the complete platform. Sign up, pick a plan and pay in minutes.

cta.title: Bring onespec to your website today
cta.subtitle: Sign up, pick a plan and publish your configurator. Secure payment with Stripe, cancel any time.

iframeExplainer.title: What's an iFrame code?
iframeExplainer.subtitle: It's the technical part of onespec, and it's the only one. No developer needed, nothing on your existing site gets touched.

points.title: It's a window inside your site
points.body: The iFrame shows an external page inside one of your pages. Visitors see the configurator as if it were part of your site: no page change, no leaving you.

points.title: You paste it once
points.body: Copy the code and paste it wherever you want the configurator to appear. Works with WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow or a hand-built site: it's standard HTML.

points.title: It updates itself
points.body: The content lives on our servers. When you change the price list or colors from the platform, the code on your site stays identical and the configurator is already updated.

iframeExplainer.footnote: Only one line changes from customer to customer: <id>tuo-id</id>. Everything else is identical for everyone.

hero.title: A widget, not a software project
hero.subtitle: onespec was born from a direct request by window and door manufacturers and dealers: an interactive configurator that saves time, filters out serious requests and protects your prices from unfair competition.

configurator.title: Try it the way your customer does
configurator.subtitle: Two interactive demos, identical to the product. Try them side by side: the configurator for your customers and the one for your team. On your site you use your own price list and brand.

blocks.title: 1. Import your price list
blocks.description: Upload a CSV file with materials, glazing, finishes and hardware with their prices, then complete sizes and pricing rules from the platform, without retyping everything by hand.

blocks.title: 2. Brand the widget
blocks.description: Choose colors, fonts, logo and copy for the configurator from the platform. The result is a widget that looks built specifically for your site, not an external plugin.

blocks.title: 3. Paste the iFrame code
blocks.description: A single snippet to paste on your site's page. The configurator is responsive by default: designed for mobile and desktop, not just adapted.

blocks.title: 4. Always update from the platform
blocks.description: Change prices, add products or edit discount rules from the onespec dashboard. Changes go live on every site where the widget is installed, without touching the client's code.

dashboard.title: The dashboard that controls it all
dashboard.subtitle: Requests received, most configured products, average quote value. From here you update price lists and rules, and changes go live wherever the widget is installed.

midCta.title: Less time on curious visitors, more time on ready buyers
midCta.subtitle: The configurator collects sizes, materials and budget before you even pick up the phone. Whoever contacts you after configuring has already decided to buy.

referralPage.metaDescription: Bring another company to OneSpec: you receive 10% of its subscription price, it gets 10% off its first payment.

hero.title: Bring another company to OneSpec and get a reward
hero.subtitle: You receive 10% of its subscription price (VAT excluded), as credit or as money in your Stripe account. It gets 10% off its first payment.

steps.title: Share your link
steps.description: From the platform you get a personal code and link to send to another company in the window industry.

steps.title: The company signs up and picks a plan
steps.description: Its 10% discount is applied automatically to the first payment, with no code to enter.

steps.title: You receive the reward
steps.description: After the first payment and 30 days without refunds, you receive 10% of the plan price, VAT excluded: as credit on your subscription or as money in your Stripe account.

referralPage.amountsNote: The reward is 10% of the list price of the plan chosen by the invited company, VAT excluded, once per company.
referralPage.annualNote: With yearly billing (where available) reward and discount are 10% of the yearly price. Prices exclude VAT. The Enterprise plan is agreed with us.
rules: Owners and admins of an account with an active subscription can invite.
The reward matures after the invited company's first real payment and 30 days without refunds or disputes.
At most 10 rewards every 12 months per account.
Invitations between accounts of the same person or company, or using the same payment card, do not earn a reward.
A cash reward is a fee for the referral: tax treatment is the recipient's responsibility.
